clean.explanation: Plain object-oriented class performing arithmetic only; no Cloud-incompatible statements.

native-sql.explanation: Uses EXEC SQL (native SQL), which is not allowed in ABAP Cloud; replace with ABAP SQL or a released AMDP.

list-output.explanation: Classic WRITE list output is unavailable in ABAP Cloud; expose data via a RAP service / OData instead.

dynpro.explanation: Executable report with dynpro (CALL SCREEN / MODULE) and report events; rebuild the UI as a Fiori app on a RAP service and move logic into a class.

mixed.explanation: Native SQL via EXEC SQL must be replaced with ABAP SQL before this can run in ABAP Cloud.
